identity.description: Help Scout is a customer support helpdesk/shared inbox product with an Inbox (Mailbox) API 2.0, Docs API, Beacon chat widget, Chat API, and an Apps platform.
identity.identity_notes: Pages from developer.helpscout.com and docs.helpscout.com describe the Help Scout product, its Inbox/Mailbox API, Docs API, webhooks and Apps. Matches the named product at helpscout.com.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization Code flow (for integrations other Help Scout users install) and Client Credentials flow (for internal integrations). Token endpoint: https://api.helpscout.net/v2/oauth2/token
auth.token_refresh: Client Credentials token valid for 2 days (expires_in 172800); create a new one after expiry. Refresh signaled by HTTP 401 and uses refresh_token grant at the same token endpoint. Refresh behavior for Client Credentials not explained.
auth.scopes_notes: No scope list found on the pages reviewed. Docs API uses an API key sent over HTTP Basic auth (key as username, dummy password), per developer.helpscout.com/llms.txt summary.

access.production_restrictions: No app-review or public-listing gate found in pages reviewed. API access is plan-gated: Free plan has no API access; Standard is 200 calls/min without reporting endpoints; Plus 400/min and Pro 800/min with all endpoints. Credentials must be tied to an active, invited user in the account.

write_ops: create/update conversations and customers (per llms.txt summary, not verified at endpoint level)
api.rate_limits: Inbox API: 200 requests per minute per account, plus burst limit of 12 write requests per 5 seconds (llms.txt summary). Plan-based: Standard 200/min, Plus 400/min, Pro 800/min (Mailbox API article).
api.limitations: Rate limits are per account and plan-based. Standard plan has no reporting endpoints. No official standalone API client SDK was confirmed; JavaScript SDK and React UI Kit are for Help Scout apps, not the REST API.
